thesis_summary.thesis: IonQ, Inc. is a U.S. public quantum computing company building trapped-ion quantum systems and selling access through quantum-computing-as-a-service (QCaaS), specialized hardware contracts, and consulting on quantum algorithms. **[Fact]** The company has expanded through acquisitions into quantum networking (id Quantique), satellite synthetic-aperture radar imagery (Capella Space), ion-trap chip technology (Oxford Ionics), atomic clocks and sensors (Vector Atomic), and quantum networking infrastructure (Skyloom Global, closed January 2026). **[Fact]** FY2025 revenue was **$130.0 million** (+202% versus **$43.1 million** in FY2024). **[Fact]** FY2025 net loss was **$512.1 million** and net cash used in operating activities was **$283.2 million** (10-K FY2025 MD&A). **[Fact]** At March 31, 2026, cash was **$493.5 million** (down from **$1,030.9 million** at December 31, 2025) on **358.8 million** basic weighted-average shares (10-Q Q1 2026).
thesis_summary.why_market_wrong: **Predictive attribute:** quantum platform narrative versus normalized owner cash burn (revenue acceleration versus operating losses and dilution).

key_assumptions.input: Starting free cash flow per share
key_assumptions.source: Normalized owner cash per share after growth R&D and acquisition integration; FY2025 OCF ($283.2M) is ($0.79/sh at ~359M shares) and Q1 2026 operating loss ($271.5M) on revenue $64.7M (10-K FY2025 MD&A; 10-Q Q1 2026). Lawrence base uses a small positive run-rate path, not Q1 GAAP net income inflated by $1,057.6M warrant fair-value gain.
Contract revenue scales on specialized hardware builds and QCaaS; acquired Capella/Skyloom revenue embedded; R&D intensity moderates post-integration
